_comment: What the CBA configuration must hold (HR-driven identity guide, Gate 5). The issuing CAs the card program uses, by thumbprint; the policy OIDs of its PIV authentication certificates, which must map to multifactor; and the limits Learn's CRL page gives per cloud. The CA names, thumbprints and OIDs are fictional. warnPercent and caExpiryWarnDays are design guidance. Learn gives the CRL limits in MB; the check reads them as decimal megabytes (1 MB = 1,000,000 bytes), the stricter reading.
